identity.admin_api_operation: CREATE_USER only; never UPDATE or reset
identity.role_assessment: candidate only; broad access to all configuration variables, including normally superuser-visible variables; no pg_settings view is queried; explicit Cloud SQL users.insert acceptance of PostgreSQL predefined roles is not documented and requires review
identity.fallback: forbidden: omitted or empty databaseRoles could grant cloudsqlsuperuser

resources.secret_version_policy: numeric version only; payload generated in process memory and sent directly to regional AddSecretVersion; never Terraform state, logs, arguments, or report
iam: roles/cloudsql.client conditioned to exact SQL instance
roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor on exact regional W8 secret only
roles/artifactregistry.reader for the exact repository service agent

sequence: read exact Cloud SQL metadata, user inventory, and regional secret metadata
abort before credential generation on login collision, secret version collision, target mismatch, or incomplete metadata
obtain separate review of the broad candidate role and Admin API role acceptance
generate high-entropy password in memory only
append version to the exact pre-existing regional secret and retain only the numeric version identifier
CREATE_USER with type BUILT_IN and explicit databaseRoles=[pg_read_all_settings]
prepare exact resource plan and one isolated Job pinned to a reviewed immutable image digest
run the allowlisted catalog query once after a separately approved execution release

abort_reconciliation.collision: abort; never reset an existing login or secret version
abort_reconciliation.secret_add_error: uncertain result retains exact release journal; no retry or login creation
abort_reconciliation.user_create_error: only delete the exact newly-created numeric secret version after definitive API failure; uncertain result is retained for reconciliation
abort_reconciliation.job_create_error: retain version and login when outcome is uncertain; reconcile exact resources before retry

teardown: delete only the exact W8 Job and dedicated service account and bindings created by the release
delete login only when release journal proves this run created it
destroy only the exact numeric secret version created by this run
preserve Cloud SQL instance/database, VPC/subnet, Artifact Registry repository, pre-existing secret metadata, remote Terraform state, and unrelated resources

cost_estimate_usd.secret_manager_free_quota_account_usage: unknown; estimate is gross and excludes any free quota

review_gates: decide whether pg_read_all_settings broad privilege is acceptable or select a narrower supported role
confirm official Cloud SQL users.insert support for the selected databaseRoles value before any create call
review SQL allowlist and local PostgreSQL 18 fixture evidence
approve exact image digest, active numeric secret version, IAM plan, cost, and teardown plan
separate explicit authorization for all Cloud writes and later Job execution
